mentions.name: Bayesian-optimized quantum photonics eraser experiment
mentions.description: A quantum photonics experiment, a variation of the quantum eraser, in which about a dozen motorized wave plates and other optical components are under computer control. Bayesian optimization drives the setup: given a goal metric such as 'maximally entangle the photon pairs', the optimizer runs the experiment 50-100 times, tweaking the angles of various optics and collecting data to maximize the cost function, using the M-LOOP optimization tool originally developed for creating Bose-Einstein condensates.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building a quantum photonics experiment that is a variation of the quantum eraser.

One aspect that HN may find interesting is my use of Bayesian optimization to control and perfect key experimental settings. About a dozen of the wave plates and other optical components are motorized and under computer control.
